title_en: 38/45 RPM Record Adapter & Vinyl Record Weight Stabilizer Aluminum Alloy Turntable Disc Clamp for 7-Inch & 12-Inch LP Records(Black)
description_en: 2-IN-1 45 RPM ADAPTER & RECORD STABILIZER: Dual-purpose turntable accessory designed for both 7-inch (45 RPM) large-hole singles and 12-inch (33 1/3 RPM) LP vinyl records.
